CHANNEL_URL.description: The URL of the Youtube channelto sync. This variable is required and must be set to a valid Youtube channel URL.

FILTER_FILE.description: An optional text file containing filter instructions for which videos to add to Pachinko. If set, the file should contain plain text instructions that can be evaluated against each videos's title and transcript. If not set or empty, all videos will be added to Pachinko unconditionally.
